name: sol-advisor
description: Codex-native 0.7.0 workflow that reserves high-value judgment for Sol and delegates bounded execution to Luna V2 under active-child scope locks and terminal coordination barriers.

interface.shortDescription: 0.7.0: Sol owns judgment; native Luna V2 runs bounded work under scope locks and terminal barriers.
interface.longDescription: Sol Advisor 0.7.0 routes every request by default. Sol primary keeps intent, architecture/contracts, authorization, risk, option selection, integration, and acceptance; native Luna V2 proactively gathers cited repository evidence when the real runtime path or implementation location is unknown, then receives exact bounded questions or a decision-complete coherent repository write phase. Each child has an active-child ownership ledger, and dependent phases wait for terminal predecessors before handoff inspection or acceptance. Atomic one-file micro-edits may stay primary only when the strict micro-edit boundary holds; multi-file and cross-repository phases go to a worker. Browser/runtime QA honors an exact user-selected tool without fallback; default or generic QA probes capabilities and uses the desktop Chrome extension, registered headless chrome-devtools-mcp, then an already-installed runnable Playwright CLI as last fallback, or blocks with exact missing capabilities. App-task Luna and legacy Terra/Sol remain explicit compatibility options.
defaultPrompt: Route through Sol Advisor 0.7.0; keep judgment in Sol and delegate Luna Max work under ownership locks and terminal barriers.
Use app-task Luna or legacy Terra/Sol only when I explicitly authorize compatibility.
